**User Entity:** JPA entity with fields for id, username, email, password, firstName, lastName, role, active status, timestamps

**Role Enum:** USER, ADMIN, MODERATOR

**API Endpoints:**
- POST /api/users - Create user (public)
- GET /api/users - Get all users (ADMIN/MODERATOR)
- GET /api/users/{id} - Get user by ID (ADMIN/MODERATOR or owner)
- GET /api/users/username/{username} - Get by username (ADMIN/MODERATOR)
- PUT /api/users/{id} - Update user (ADMIN or owner)
- DELETE /api/users/{id} - Delete user (ADMIN)
- PATCH /api/users/{id}/deactivate - Deactivate user (ADMIN/MODERATOR)
- GET /api/users/active - Get active users (ADMIN/MODERATOR)
- GET /api/users/role/{role} - Get by role (ADMIN)
- GET /api/users/search - Search users (ADMIN/MODERATOR)

**Services:**
- UserService: Core business logic for user CRUD operations
- ExternalApiService: External API integrations (email verification, notifications, profile enrichment, GDPR deletion)

**Security:**
- CustomUserDetailsService: Loads user details from database
- SecurityConfig: Stateless security with BCrypt password encoding
- UserSecurity: Custom authorization expressions for owner checks

**Database:**
- H2 in-memory database (development: userdb, test: testdb)
- Auto DDL creation/drop
- JPA with Hibernate

**Exception Handling:**
- Global exception handler with custom error responses
- Support for validation errors, entity not found, illegal arguments, and access denied scenarios

**Testing:**
- JUnit 5 integration tests
- Spring Boot Test with @SpringBootTest
- Tests for create, read, update, deactivate operations
- Duplicate validation tests
